wowFactor.evidence: Evaluated as developer tooling, the workflow produces useful enforcement and feedback: successful regression tests do not override rejected or stale real features. Build logs remain retainable while Pages configure/upload require a successful critic outcome and deployment depends on both build and critic-gate. The retained initial rejection and correction demonstrate that the builder responds to concrete critic feedback. This score does not imply product visual, audio or whole-world quality.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: Independent qualitative review is combined with strict per-category grades, durable rejection history, exact reviewed-file fingerprints and separate build/evidence versus acceptance handling. LF-normalized hashes avoid platform checkout noise while still detecting substantive changes. The recorded limitations preserve human/agent responsibility for scope and honest evidence, and the checker provides practical protection against silently reusing stale approval.
